response.sql:
WITH site_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(CAST(sm.facetfaces AS REAL)) as site_avg_faces
  FROM sites s
  LEFT JOIN scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
  WHERE sm.facetfaces IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    entrystat,
    AVG(site_avg_faces) as status_avg_faces
  FROM site_averages
  WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY entrystat
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(site_avg_faces) as overall_avg
  FROM site_averages
),
above_status_sites AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.site_avg_faces,
    st.status_avg_faces
  FROM site_averages sa
  JOIN status_averages st ON sa.entrystat = st.entrystat
  WHERE sa.site_avg_faces > st.status_avg_faces
)
SELECT 
  AVG(ass.site_avg_faces) as avg_face_count,
  AVG(ass.site_avg_faces) - oa.overall_avg as above_overall_avg,
  AVG(ass.site_avg_faces - ass.status_avg_faces) as above_status_avg
FROM above_status_sites ass
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa

assumptions.assumption: "Overall average number of mesh faces across all the matched data" refers to the average of per-site averages (computed from site-level mean facetfaces), including sites without an access status, rather than a grand average of all individual facetfaces values. This interpretation aligns with the request's focus on site-level comparisons.

Sites with no mesh records or only NULL facetfaces values are excluded from all averages (they do not appear in site_averages); a NULL entrystat site is included in the overall_average but excluded from the filtering step (not joined to status_averages).
"Strictly above" means > (not >=) when comparing site average to status average.

alternatives.interpretation: "Overall average number of mesh faces across all the matched data" means the grand average of all individual facetfaces values from all scanmesh records (not the average of site-level averages). This interprets "matched data" as the underlying mesh records rather than the computed site-level summaries.
